# IRIS RESEARCH
Purpose: autonomous visual evidence acquisition before rendering.

INPUT
subject / scene / asset / references / constraints

PROCESS
1. Decompose the requested visual into research questions.
2. Identify authoritative source classes.
3. Search / inspect available evidence.
4. Cross-check significant visual claims.
5. Extract dimensions, proportions, geometry, materials, context, period, environment, markings and distinguishing details.
6. Classify findings as VERIFIED / HIGH-CONFIDENCE / PLAUSIBLE / SPECULATIVE.
7. Build a concise visual evidence brief.
8. Hand unresolved technical issues to the owning expert rather than the user.
9. Ask the user only if the missing fact is user-owned and materially changes the output.

OUTPUT
REFERENCE BRIEF
DESIGN CONSTRAINTS
OPEN RISKS
RENDER-READY FACTS
